templates.name: vallon zek
templates.note: 'just another melee raid mob ... He quads hard, that is it'; 'Nukes do close to nothing on him, kinda like Rallos Zek. However, debuffs work'; 'he has a aoe nuke but it doesn't even do much damage' (Gonzales, CS 2009-04-10); 'ZP gods all debuff AC' (CS zpgods, the old gods). Videos 2009: 98 hits on a L60 warrior 2415-4531, a floor ~3520, 4 a round every 6.05 s (cv1CBnSk6bY, RDRs_99a1Ag): 3,520 here; effective HP 2.1-2.9M in three kills (400 DPS a raider, ours) at the share a L60 raid deals a L68 (45%): 1.0M. Level, resists, AoE ours.

templates.name: guard of vallon
templates.note: Vallon's friends: 'the roamers that spawn with him ... equivilent to about a Oasis Desert Pillager'; 'as soon as you kill them, another spawns in hits place' (Shorte, BlackPearl 2009-02-23); fewer after 2009-04-02 ('Vallon reduction of number of minions', SOE); 'Guard of Vallon', red con, 'they keep spawning' (videos 2009-02, 2010-02). Count and figures ours.

npcs.name: Guard of Vallon
npcs.note: Spawned with Vallon Zek (guide gaps vallon).

triggers.name: Vallon Zek

steps.text: Vallon Zek: You have found my training grounds. Let me show you how Zek trains! (Ninety minutes.)
Vallon Zek: You have won the battle, but not the war!
Vallon Zek has fallen. His training grounds will not hold you long.

triggers.notes: Spoken to, Vallon 'respawns kos along with some friends' (CS 2009-04-10); 'you have 90 minutes from spawn time' (Monoxxide). Won, lost or timed out, the isle is cleared and the raid sent back to the plateau's port-in (ours: no record of how raids left). The Rage of Zek ('quad for 150k', 'AOE DT') was the bug Kekoo owned: not built.

triggers.name: Guards of Vallon
triggers.notes: A guard's death (npcdeath) brings another in 15 s, three at most: 'as soon as you kill them, another spawns' (Shorte, 2009-02-23). Stopped when Vallon falls or his clock ends.

deaths.name: Guard of Vallon
deaths.note: 'as soon as you kill them, another spawns in hits place' (Shorte, BlackPearl 2009-02-23).
